verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Qodo serves an llms.txt at https://docs.qodo.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. Agentic Toolbox docs for CLI, MCP and agent plugins add further agent-facing material. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants, and evidence of how complete or deep the llms.txt index is.
